title: integer division produces exact rationals
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.3: `/` on integer categories gives an exact rat; rat.string() is canonical n/d or just n when d = 1 (book 5.2: (1/3 + 2/3).string() is "1"). language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): int / int is rat, and rat combines with int only after an explicit .rat(), so the second division divides by 5.rat().
